title: DeepSeek V4 Pro extends discount and adds 1M context inside Claude Code
summary: The DeepSeek team extended a 75 percent API discount for DeepSeek V4 Pro through 31 May and shipped a one-million-token context window directly inside Claude Code via the deepseek-v4-pro-1m model tag, along with compatibility updates for Open Code and OpenClaw.

web_findings.snippet: Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic; DeepSeek as Anthropic-compatible backend.
